sloka: तत् आश्वासय हि इमम् त्वम् किम् न्व् इदम् यन् मही पतिः ।वसुधा आसक्त नयनो मन्दम् अश्रूणि मुन्चति ॥२-१९-९॥
transliteration: tat āśvāsaya hi imam tvam kim nv idam yan mahī patiḥ ।vasudhā āsakta nayano mandam aśrūṇi muncati ॥2-19-9॥

translations.english: Please console him. Why is it that the king with his eyes fixed upon the ground is shedding tears drop by drop?
